summary: Siskiyou County, CA lookout on the Klamath NF: a BC-301 cabin built 1934, replaced in 1954 by a mobile cupola trailer; removal date unknown, original foundation reported visible.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on a 10-foot enclosed timber tower; 1954 replacement was an R1M Region 1 mobile cupola trailer
facts.status_note: Removal date unknown; the register says the original foundation remains visible today
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Klamath National Forest

events.note: Build field on the register page reads 1934/1954; the first structure was a BC-301 cabin on a 10-foot timber tower
Walter Carruthers was the lookout in July 1935; Ed Farnsworth replaced him that August
Lookout Johnny Roff spotted a small blaze during a lightning storm on July 29 and directed a crew by radio
William Campbell, lookout for several years, moved to the Blue Ridge station for the 1946 season
Paul Farmer went to the Cecil Point lookout
Original structure replaced with an R1M Region 1 Mobile Cupola Trailer
Eileen Johnson had served as lookout there for the last four summers
